title: Butternut Squash Noodle Soup with Turkey
description: This quick and easy turkey soup substitutes spiralized butternut squash for traditional noodles, putting a twist on this fall-flavored meal.
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon ground chipotle chile pepper, or to taste
0.75 butternut squash, peeled and cut into noodle shapes
1 teaspoon chopped fresh cilantro, or more to taste

steps.text: Combine chicken broth, celery, onion, garlic, Mexican oregano, and ground chipotle in a large pot; bring to a boil. Cover and reduce heat; simmer until vegetables are softened, about 20 minutes.
Stir butternut squash and turkey into the broth mixture; simmer until turkey is heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.

video.description: When the cold weather is all around, a hot, comforting noodle soup is always welcome for nourishing warmth. Cut out the carbs and dial up the nutrition with this flavorful variation on the classic noodle soup that replaces pasta with spiralized butternut squash and features low-sodium broth, chopped celery, onion, garlic and Mexican oregano, chipotle chili pepper and lean turkey. After a good simmer, garnish with cilantro and serve the deliciousness all around.
